en: The Sultanate of Golconda as an early modern kingdom in southern India ruled by the Persianate, Shia Qutb Shahi dynasty of Turkoman origin
Its establishment in 1518 by Quli Qutb Shah after the decline of the Bahmani Sultanate
Its place among the five Deccan sultanates
zh: 戈尔孔达苏丹国是南印度的近代早期王国，由土库曼出身的波斯文化什叶派库特卜沙希王朝统治
1518年巴赫曼尼苏丹国衰落后由顾利·库特卜·沙建立
是德干五苏丹国之一

politics.zh: 戈尔孔达苏丹国是南印度的近代早期王国，由土库曼出身、文化上波斯化的什叶派库特卜沙希王朝统治。1518年，巴赫曼尼苏丹国衰落后，顾利·库特卜·沙建立该苏丹国，成为德干五苏丹国之一，都城先设在戈尔孔达，后迁至海得拉巴。王国与比贾布尔、艾哈迈德讷格尔等德干政权时分时合，1687年为莫卧儿帝国所灭。
politics.en: The Sultanate of Golconda was an early modern kingdom in southern India ruled by the Persianate, Shia Qutb Shahi dynasty of Turkoman origin. After the decline of the Bahmani Sultanate it was established in 1518 by Quli Qutb Shah as one of the five Deccan sultanates, with its capital first at Golconda and later at Hyderabad. It allied and quarrelled by turns with Bijapur, Ahmadnagar and the other Deccan powers until the Mughal Empire conquered it in 1687.

economy.zh: 苏丹国以科卢尔等地的钻石矿闻名，戈尔孔达与海得拉巴是钻石与纺织品的贸易中心，灌溉农业与手工业支撑城市经济，钻石出口远达波斯与欧洲市场。
economy.en: The sultanate was famous for its diamond mines, above all at Kollur, and Golconda and Hyderabad were centres of the diamond and textile trade, with irrigated farming and crafts supporting the urban economy and diamonds exported as far as Persia and Europe.

culture.zh: 库特卜沙希宫廷是德干波斯文化与泰卢固、乌尔都文学的交汇点，海得拉巴的查尔米纳等建筑是这一时期的地标，波斯语与德干地方语言并用。
culture.en: The Qutb Shahi court was a meeting point of Deccani Persian culture with Telugu and Urdu literature, landmarks such as the Charminar in Hyderabad date from this period, and Persian and local Deccani languages were used side by side.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1518年建国、16世纪与毗奢耶那伽罗及德干诸国的战争、1591年海得拉巴建城，以及1687年被莫卧儿帝国吞并。
events.en: Key moments are the founding in 1518, the wars with Vijayanagara and the other Deccan states in the sixteenth century, the founding of Hyderabad in 1591 and the Mughal conquest of 1687. Its last ruler was sent to Delhi as a prisoner.

value.zh: 1518年由顾利·库特卜·沙建立。
value.en: It was established in 1518 by Quli Qutb Shah.

value.zh: 1687年被莫卧儿帝国吞并。
value.en: The Mughal Empire conquered it in 1687.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 中文维基百科没有该苏丹国的条目（该实体没有中文 sitelink），叙述依据英文维基百科条目与维基数据实体。
entries.scopeNoteEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no article on this sultanate, the entity having no zhwiki sitelink, so the essay rests on the English article and the Wikidata entity.

en: Panama as a country at the southern end of Central America, bordering South America
Its borders with Costa Rica to the west and Colombia to the south-east, the Caribbean to the north and the Pacific to the south
Panama City as capital and largest city
zh: 巴拿马是中美洲南端、与南美洲接壤的国家
西邻哥斯达黎加，东南接哥伦比亚，北临加勒比海，南濒太平洋
首都与最大城市为巴拿马城

politics.zh: 巴拿马共和国是中美洲南端、与南美洲相接的国家，西邻哥斯达黎加，东南与哥伦比亚接壤，北临加勒比海，南濒太平洋，首都与最大城市为巴拿马城。1903年脱离哥伦比亚独立，此后长期与美国就运河区的关系交织，1977年条约确定运河逐步移交，1999年底巴拿马收回运河全部管理权。
politics.en: The Republic of Panama is a country at the southern end of Central America, bordering South America, with Costa Rica to the west, Colombia to the south-east, the Caribbean to the north and the Pacific to the south, and Panama City as its capital and largest city. It became independent from Colombia in 1903, and its history was long bound up with the United States over the Canal Zone; the treaties of 1977 provided for a gradual transfer, and Panama took over the full administration of the canal at the end of 1999.

economy.zh: 经济以运河航运、科隆自由贸易区、金融服务与旅游为支柱，运河通行费与相关物流收入是国家财政的重要来源，农业出产香蕉、咖啡与糖。
economy.en: The economy rests on canal shipping, the Colon free trade zone, financial services and tourism, with canal tolls and related logistics an important source of state revenue, while agriculture produces bananas, coffee and sugar. The canal expansion of 2016 widened the waterway.

culture.zh: 巴拿马文化融合西班牙殖民传统、非洲裔与本地原住民影响，西班牙语为官方语言，狂欢节与音乐传统鲜明，运河与多元移民历史塑造了国家认同。
culture.en: Panamanian culture combines Spanish colonial tradition with African and indigenous influences, Spanish is the official language, carnival and music are distinctive, and the canal and a history of diverse immigration have shaped national identity. Its literature and music reflect that mixture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1821年脱离西班牙加入哥伦比亚、1903年独立、1914年运河通航、1977年条约与1999年运河移交。
events.en: Key moments are independence from Spain and union with Colombia in 1821, independence in 1903, the opening of the canal in 1914 and the treaties of 1977 with the transfer of the canal in 1999.

value.zh: 1903年脱离哥伦比亚独立。
value.en: It became independent from Colombia in 1903.

value.zh: 1999年底收回运河全部管理权。
value.en: It took over the full administration of the canal at the end of 1999.

en: Argentina, officially the Argentine Republic, as a country in the far south of South America
An area of 2,780,085 square kilometres, the second largest in South America after Brazil
Its sharing of the bulk of the Southern Cone with Chile
zh: 阿根廷正式称阿根廷共和国，位于南美洲最南部
面积2,780,085平方公里，是南美洲仅次于巴西的第二大国
与智利共占南锥体大部分地区

politics.zh: 阿根廷共和国位于南美洲最南部，面积2,780,085平方公里，是南美洲第二大、美洲第四大、世界第八大国家，与智利共同占据南锥体大部。国家为联邦制总统共和国，由23个省与自治市布宜诺斯艾利斯组成，1816年宣告独立，此后经历长期的政治动荡与军人干预，1983年恢复民主制度。
politics.en: The Argentine Republic lies in the far south of South America, covering 2,780,085 square kilometres, the second largest country in South America after Brazil, the fourth largest in the Americas and the eighth largest in the world, and sharing the bulk of the Southern Cone with Chile. It is a federal presidential republic of twenty-three provinces and the autonomous city of Buenos Aires; independence was declared in 1816, and after long political instability and military intervention democracy was restored in 1983.

economy.zh: 经济以农牧业、食品加工与制造业为基础，大豆、小麦、牛肉与葡萄酒是传统出口品，潘帕斯草原是核心农业区，布宜诺斯艾利斯是工业与金融中心。
economy.en: The economy rests on agriculture and livestock, food processing and manufacturing, with soybeans, wheat, beef and wine as traditional exports, the Pampas as the core farming region and Buenos Aires as the centre of industry and finance.

culture.zh: 阿根廷文化融合西班牙与意大利移民传统与原住民遗产，西班牙语为官方语言，探戈与足球是国家文化标志，文学与电影在拉美具有重要影响。
culture.en: Argentine culture combines Spanish and Italian immigrant traditions with indigenous heritage, Spanish is the official language, tango and football are national cultural markers, and its literature and cinema are influential in Latin America. Buenos Aires dominates the country's publishing and theatre.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1816年独立、19世纪的建国与移民浪潮、20世纪的庇隆主义与军人执政，以及1983年恢复民主与2001年经济危机。
events.en: Key moments are independence in 1816, nation-building and mass immigration in the nineteenth century, Peronism and military rule in the twentieth, the restoration of democracy in 1983 and the economic crisis of 2001. The country has since held regular elections.

value.zh: 面积2,780,085平方公里，居南美第二。
value.en: It covers 2,780,085 square kilometres, the second largest in South America.

value.zh: 1816年宣告独立。
value.en: It declared independence in 1816.

en: The Confederate States of America, also called the Confederacy, as a republic in the Southern United States from 1861 to 1865
Its lack of recognition as a sovereign nation by foreign governments and by the United States
Its formation on 8 February 1861 by seven states that had seceded
zh: 美利坚联盟国又称联盟国，是1861至1865年美国南部的共和国
未获外国政府与美国承认其主权国家地位
1861年2月8日由七个脱离联邦的州组成

politics.zh: 美利坚联盟国又称联盟国，是1861至1865年间存在于美国南部的共和国，由七个脱离联邦的州于1861年2月8日组成，此后又有四个州加入。它设有总统、国会与军队，但始终未获外国政府与美国对其主权国家地位的承认；1865年南北战争结束后瓦解，各州重新并入美国。
politics.en: The Confederate States of America, also known as the Confederacy, was a republic in the Southern United States from 1861 to 1865, formed on 8 February 1861 by seven states that had seceded, joined later by four more. It had a president, a congress and an army, but was never recognised as a sovereign nation by foreign governments or by the United States; it collapsed at the end of the Civil War in 1865 and its states rejoined the Union.

economy.zh: 联盟国经济以棉花等种植园农业为基础，严重依赖奴隶劳动与对欧洲的棉花出口，战争期间的封锁使贸易与财政陷入困境，通货膨胀与物资短缺贯穿始终。
economy.en: The Confederate economy rested on plantation agriculture, above all cotton, and depended heavily on slave labour and on cotton exports to Europe; the wartime blockade crippled trade and public finance, and inflation and shortages persisted throughout.

culture.zh: 联盟国以南方白人社会的奴隶制秩序为基础，其政治话语强调州权与地方自治，同时维护并扩展奴隶制度，这一遗产在战后美国社会长期存在争议。
culture.en: The Confederacy rested on the slaveholding order of white southern society, and its political language emphasised states' rights and local self-government while defending and extending slavery, a legacy contested in American society long after the war.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1860至1861年南方各州脱离联邦、1861年2月组建联盟国、1861至1865年南北战争，以及1865年投降与解体。
events.en: Key moments are the secession of the southern states in 1860-1861, the formation of the Confederacy in February 1861, the Civil War of 1861-1865 and its surrender and dissolution in 1865. Its leaders were tried and its constitution annulled.

value.zh: 1861年2月8日由七个脱离联邦的州组成。
value.en: It was formed on 8 February 1861 by seven seceding states.

value.zh: 未获外国政府与美国承认其主权地位。
value.en: It was never recognised as sovereign by foreign governments or the United States.

en: Denmark as a Nordic country in Northern Europe and the metropole of the Kingdom of Denmark
Its place as the most populous constituent of the Danish Realm
The Realm's inclusion of the autonomous territories of the Faroe Islands and Greenland
zh: 丹麦是北欧国家，也是丹麦王国的本土部分
是丹麦王国人口最多的构成部分
王国包括法罗群岛与格陵兰两个自治领地

politics.zh: 丹麦是北欧国家，也是丹麦王国（又称丹麦王国）的本土与人口最多的构成部分；王国是由宪法统一的单一制国家，包括北大西洋上的法罗群岛与格陵兰两个自治领地。本土由日德兰半岛与西兰等岛屿组成，首都为哥本哈根，实行议会制君主立宪，国王为国家元首。
politics.en: Denmark is a Nordic country in Northern Europe and the metropole and most populous constituent of the Kingdom of Denmark, also called the Danish Realm, a constitutionally unitary state that includes the autonomous territories of the Faroe Islands and Greenland in the north Atlantic. Metropolitan Denmark consists of the Jutland peninsula and the islands including Zealand, its capital is Copenhagen, and it is a parliamentary monarchy with a king as head of state.

economy.zh: 经济以服务业、制造业、航运与农业为基础，医药、风力发电设备、海运与设计产业在国际市场占有重要地位，猪肉与乳制品是重要农产品出口。
economy.en: The economy rests on services, manufacturing, shipping and agriculture, with pharmaceuticals, wind-power equipment, shipping and design holding important places in international markets, and pork and dairy products among the leading farm exports. The country is a net exporter of food.

culture.zh: 丹麦文化以维京传统、路德宗与平等主义社会为底色，丹麦语为通用语言，童话作家安徒生与设计传统享誉国际，法罗群岛与格陵兰保留自己的语言与文化。
culture.en: Danish culture is rooted in Viking tradition, Lutheranism and an egalitarian society, Danish is the common language, the fairy-tale writer Andersen and Danish design are internationally known, and the Faroes and Greenland keep their own languages and cultures.

events.zh: 关键节点包括10世纪王国形成、14世纪卡尔马联合、19世纪失去挪威与石勒苏益格-荷尔斯泰因、1849年立宪，以及20世纪福利国家与自治领地安排。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the kingdom in the tenth century, the Kalmar Union of the fourteenth, the loss of Norway and of Schleswig-Holstein in the nineteenth, the constitution of 1849 and the welfare state and home-rule arrangements of the twentieth century.

value.zh: 王国包括法罗群岛与格陵兰两个自治领地。
value.en: The Realm includes the autonomous territories of the Faroes and Greenland.

value.zh: 首都为哥本哈根。
value.en: Its capital is Copenhagen.

en: The Sultanate of Cirebon as an Islamic sultanate in West Java founded in the fifteenth century
Its foundation attributed to Sunan Gunungjati, marked by his letter proclaiming Cirebon's independence from Pajajaran in 1482
zh: 井里汶苏丹国是15世纪建于西爪哇的伊斯兰苏丹国
相传由苏南·古农·贾蒂建立，1482年他宣告井里汶脱离巴查查兰独立

politics.zh: 井里汶苏丹国是15世纪建于西爪哇的伊斯兰苏丹国，相传由苏南·古农·贾蒂建立，1482年他宣告井里汶脱离巴查查兰王国独立。苏丹国位于爪哇北岸，是爪哇伊斯兰化的重要中心之一，17世纪后受马打兰与荷兰东印度公司的影响，最终被荷兰殖民势力控制，其王族后裔延续至今。
politics.en: The Sultanate of Cirebon was an Islamic sultanate in West Java founded in the fifteenth century, its foundation attributed to Sunan Gunungjati and marked by his letter proclaiming Cirebon's independence from Pajajaran in 1482. Lying on the north coast of Java, it was one of the important centres of Islamisation on the island; from the seventeenth century it came under the influence of Mataram and the Dutch East India Company and was eventually controlled by Dutch colonial power, though its princely lines continue today.

economy.zh: 井里汶港位于爪哇北岸的商路上，稻米、糖、靛蓝与林产品是主要贸易物，港口连接爪哇内陆与马六甲海峡、中国及东南亚各地的贸易网络。
economy.en: The port of Cirebon lay on the north coast routes of Java, with rice, sugar, indigo and forest products as the main goods traded, linking the Javanese interior with the trade networks of the Strait of Malacca, China and Southeast Asia.

culture.zh: 井里汶是爪哇伊斯兰文化与巽他传统交汇之地，苏南·古农·贾蒂被列入爪哇九圣，宫廷的加麦兰、哇扬与手抄本传统延续至今，清真寺与王宫是重要遗产。
culture.en: Cirebon was a meeting place of Javanese Islamic culture and Sundanese tradition, Sunan Gunungjati is counted among the nine saints of Java, the court's gamelan, wayang and manuscript traditions continue, and its mosques and palaces are important legacies.

events.zh: 关键节点包括15世纪建国、1482年脱离巴查查兰、16世纪的伊斯兰化扩展，以及17世纪后受马打兰与荷兰东印度公司控制。
events.en: Key moments are the founding in the fifteenth century, the break with Pajajaran in 1482, the spread of Islamisation in the sixteenth century and the passage under Mataram and Dutch East India Company control after the seventeenth.

value.zh: 15世纪建国，相传由苏南·古农·贾蒂建立。
value.en: Founded in the fifteenth century, attributed to Sunan Gunungjati.

value.zh: 1482年宣告脱离巴查查兰独立。
value.en: It proclaimed independence from Pajajaran in 1482.

en: Malaysia as a country in Southeast Asia and a federal constitutional monarchy of thirteen states and three federal territories
Its division by the South China Sea into Peninsular Malaysia and East Malaysia on Borneo
Peninsular Malaysia's land and maritime borders with Thailand
zh: 马来西亚是东南亚国家，为联邦制君主立宪国，由13个州与3个联邦直辖区组成
被南海分为马来半岛与婆罗洲的东马两部分
马来半岛部分与泰国接壤并有海上边界

politics.zh: 马来西亚是东南亚国家，实行联邦制君主立宪，由13个州与3个联邦直辖区组成，被南海分为马来半岛的马来西亚半岛部分与婆罗洲岛上的东马两部分，马来半岛部分与泰国接壤并有海上边界，首都为吉隆坡，行政中心设在布城。国家元首由九个州的苏丹轮任，1963年由马来亚联合邦与北婆罗洲、砂拉越及新加坡组成。
politics.en: Malaysia is a country in Southeast Asia and a federal constitutional monarchy made up of thirteen states and three federal territories, divided by the South China Sea into Peninsular Malaysia on the mainland and East Malaysia on the island of Borneo; the peninsula shares land and maritime borders with Thailand, the capital is Kuala Lumpur and the administrative centre is Putrajaya. The head of state is chosen in rotation from the rulers of nine states, and the federation was formed in 1963 from the Federation of Malaya together with North Borneo, Sarawak and Singapore.

economy.zh: 经济以电子制造、棕榈油、橡胶、石油天然气与服务业为基础，槟城与巴生谷是电子与制造业中心，吉隆坡是金融与商业枢纽。
economy.en: The economy rests on electronics manufacturing, palm oil, rubber, oil and gas and services, with Penang and the Klang Valley as centres of electronics and manufacturing and Kuala Lumpur as the financial and commercial hub.

culture.zh: 马来西亚社会由马来人、华人、印度裔及原住民社群构成，伊斯兰教为联邦宗教，马来语为官方语言，英语与华语、泰米尔语广泛使用，多元节庆与饮食是其文化特征。
culture.en: Malaysian society is made up of Malay, Chinese, Indian and indigenous communities, Islam is the federal religion, Malay is the official language while English, Chinese and Tamil are widely used, and its plural festivals and cuisine are cultural hallmarks.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1957年马来亚联合邦独立、1963年马来西亚成立、1965年新加坡退出，以及20世纪后期以来的工业化与政治变动。
events.en: Key moments are the independence of the Federation of Malaya in 1957, the formation of Malaysia in 1963, the separation of Singapore in 1965 and the industrialisation and political changes since the later twentieth century.

value.zh: 1963年由马来亚联合邦与北婆罗洲、砂拉越及新加坡组成。
value.en: It was formed in 1963 from Malaya, North Borneo, Sarawak and Singapore.

value.zh: 由13个州与3个联邦直辖区组成。
value.en: It comprises thirteen states and three federal territories.

en: The Mataram kingdom, also known as the Medang kingdom, as a Javanese Hindu-Buddhist kingdom flourishing between the eighth and eleventh centuries
Its base first in Central Java and later in East Java
Its establishment by King Sanjaya and its rule by members of the Shailendra dynasty
zh: 马打兰王国又称墨棠王国，是8至11世纪兴盛的爪哇印度教-佛教王国
先以中爪哇为基地，后移至东爪哇
由散查亚王建立，沙伊伦德拉王朝成员先后统治

politics.zh: 马打兰王国又称墨棠王国，是8至11世纪间兴盛的爪哇印度教-佛教王国，先以中爪哇为基地，后移至东爪哇。王国由散查亚王建立，此后沙伊伦德拉王朝成员参与统治，10世纪在达尔马旺夏等国王时期达到鼎盛，势力及于巴厘与苏门答腊；11世纪初因内乱与外来入侵而分裂，其遗产由谏义里等后继王国继承。
politics.en: The Mataram kingdom, also known as the Medang kingdom, was a Javanese Hindu-Buddhist kingdom that flourished between the eighth and eleventh centuries, based first in Central Java and later in East Java. It was established by King Sanjaya and ruled in part by members of the Shailendra dynasty, reaching its height in the tenth century under kings such as Dharmawangsa, with influence extending to Bali and Sumatra; internal conflict and foreign attack split it in the early eleventh century, and successor kingdoms such as Kediri inherited its legacy.

economy.zh: 王国位于爪哇中部与东部的火山灰平原，稻作农业发达，控制港口与香料、稻米贸易，婆罗浮屠与普兰巴南等大型工程的修建反映了其动员人力与物资的能力。
economy.en: The kingdom lay on the volcanic plains of central and eastern Java, where rice farming was productive, and it controlled ports and the trade in spices and rice; the building of monuments such as Borobudur and Prambanan shows its capacity to mobilise labour and materials.

culture.zh: 马打兰时期是爪哇古典文化的高峰，婆罗浮屠与普兰巴南分别代表佛教与印度教建筑成就，古爪哇语文学与《罗摩衍那》爪哇改写本在此时期出现。
culture.en: The Mataram period was the high point of classical Javanese culture: Borobudur and Prambanan represent its Buddhist and Hindu architectural achievements, and Old Javanese literature, including the Javanese Ramayana, appeared in these centuries. Its temples remain the country's best-known monuments.

events.zh: 关键节点包括8世纪散查亚王立国、9世纪沙伊伦德拉王朝的统治与大型寺庙营建、10世纪的扩张，以及11世纪初的分裂与东爪哇政权的兴起。
events.en: Key moments are the founding by King Sanjaya in the eighth century, the rule of the Shailendra dynasty and the building of the great temples in the ninth, expansion in the tenth and the division of the early eleventh century with the rise of East Javanese powers.

value.zh: 婆罗浮屠与普兰巴南建于这一时期。
value.en: Borobudur and Prambanan were built in this period.

value.zh: 基地先在中爪哇，后移至东爪哇。
value.en: Its base moved from Central Java to East Java.

en: Tanjungpura as an eighth-century Malay kingdom on the south-western coast of Borneo facing the Java Sea
Its region corresponding to the present Ketapang regency of West Kalimantan
Its several moves of the royal capital, first at Negeri Baru in Ketapang
zh: 单重布啰国是8世纪位于婆罗洲西南岸、面向爪哇海的马来王国
地域相当于今西加里曼丹省吉打邦县
王都多次迁移，最初设在吉打邦的尼格里巴鲁

politics.zh: 单重布啰国是8世纪位于婆罗洲西南岸、面向爪哇海的马来王国，地域相当于今印度尼西亚西加里曼丹省吉打邦县一带。王都多次迁移，最初设在吉打邦的尼格里巴鲁，后迁往他处。王国与爪哇及苏门答腊的政权保持往来，其后裔政权延续至18世纪，最终为荷兰殖民势力控制。
politics.en: Tanjungpura was an eighth-century Malay kingdom on the south-western coast of Borneo facing the Java Sea, in a region that corresponds to the present Ketapang regency of West Kalimantan in Indonesia. Its royal capital moved several times, first at Negeri Baru in Ketapang and later elsewhere. It maintained relations with the powers of Java and Sumatra, and its successor polities lasted into the eighteenth century before Dutch colonial power took control.

economy.zh: 王国位于卡普阿斯河与爪哇海之间的沿海地带，河流是交通与贸易通道，林产品、海产与稻米是主要物产，参与爪哇海周边的区域贸易。
economy.en: The kingdom lay on the coast between the Kapuas river and the Java Sea, where rivers served as routes of transport and trade, forest products, marine goods and rice were the main products, and it took part in regional trade around the Java Sea.

culture.zh: 单重布啰属马来文化圈，马来语与本地传统结合，沿海聚落与河口贸易文化是其特点，伊斯兰教随区域贸易传入后逐渐成为主要宗教。
culture.en: Tanjungpura belonged to the Malay cultural world, where Malay and local traditions combined, its coastal settlements and river-mouth trading culture were characteristic, and Islam became the main religion as it spread with regional trade. Malay manuscripts record its rulers and their ports.

events.zh: 关键节点包括8世纪立国、王都的多次迁移、与爪哇及苏门答腊政权的往来，以及18世纪后被荷兰殖民势力控制。
events.en: Key moments are the founding in the eighth century, the repeated moves of the capital, relations with the powers of Java and Sumatra and the passage under Dutch colonial control after the eighteenth century. Its name survives in a present-day Indonesian regency.

value.zh: 位于婆罗洲西南岸，今西加里曼丹吉打邦一带。
value.en: It lay on the south-western coast of Borneo, around present-day Ketapang.

value.zh: 王都多次迁移，最初在尼格里巴鲁。
value.en: Its capital moved several times, first at Negeri Baru.

en: The Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, also called Poland-Lithuania or the First Polish Republic, as a federative real union of the Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania from 1569 to 1795
Its rank among the largest and most populous countries of sixteenth- to eighteenth-century Europe
zh: 波兰立陶宛联邦又称波兰-立陶宛或第一共和国，是1569至1795年波兰王国与立陶宛大公国的联邦制联合体
是16至18世纪欧洲面积最大、人口最多的国家之一

politics.zh: 波兰立陶宛联邦又称波兰-立陶宛或第一共和国，是1569至1795年间波兰王国与立陶宛大公国的联邦制联合体，由一位选举产生的国王与共同的议会治理，两国保留各自的军队、财政与行政。它是16至18世纪欧洲面积最大、人口最多的国家之一，实行贵族共和制与自由否决权，18世纪后期在俄、普、奥三次瓜分中灭亡。
politics.en: The Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth, also called Poland-Lithuania or the First Polish Republic, was a federative real union of the Kingdom of Poland and the Grand Duchy of Lithuania from 1569 to 1795, governed by an elected king and a common parliament while the two parts kept their own armies, finances and administration. It was among the largest and most populous countries of sixteenth- to eighteenth-century Europe and practised a noble republic with the liberum veto, disappearing in the three partitions carried out by Russia, Prussia and Austria at the end of the eighteenth century.

economy.zh: 联邦经济以维斯瓦河流域的谷物庄园为基础，粮食经格但斯克出口西欧，波罗的海贸易与内陆市集网络相连，17世纪的战争与18世纪的分割使经济长期受损。
economy.en: The Commonwealth's economy rested on grain estates in the Vistula basin, with foodstuffs exported to western Europe through Danzig and Baltic trade linked to the network of inland markets, while the wars of the seventeenth century and the partitions of the eighteenth left the economy durably damaged.

culture.zh: 联邦时期是波兰与立陶宛文化的高峰，克拉科夫与维尔纽斯大学是学术中心，文艺复兴与巴洛克建筑、拉丁语与波兰语文学、天主教与多宗教共存构成其文化面貌。
culture.en: The Commonwealth was a high point of Polish and Lithuanian culture: the universities of Krakow and Vilnius were centres of learning, Renaissance and Baroque architecture, Latin and Polish literature, and the coexistence of Catholicism with other religions shaped its culture.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1569年卢布林合并、17世纪的战争与衰落、1772至1795年的三次瓜分，以及1791年五三宪法这一早期成文宪法。
events.en: Key moments are the Union of Lublin in 1569, the wars and decline of the seventeenth century, the three partitions between 1772 and 1795 and the constitution of 3 May 1791, one of the earliest written constitutions.

value.zh: 1569年卢布林合并成立联邦。
value.en: It was created by the Union of Lublin in 1569.

value.zh: 1795年第三次瓜分后灭亡。
value.en: It disappeared in the third partition of 1795.

en: The Jagiellonian dynasty, also known as the House of Jagiellon, as a Polish cadet branch of the Lithuanian ducal dynasty of the Gediminids
Its rule over Poland, Lithuania, Bohemia and Hungary in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries
zh: 雅盖洛王朝又称雅盖隆家族，是立陶宛格迪米纳斯公爵王朝的波兰支系
15至16世纪统治波兰、立陶宛、波希米亚与匈牙利

politics.zh: 雅盖洛王朝又称雅盖隆家族，是立陶宛格迪米纳斯公爵王朝的波兰支系。1386年雅盖洛与波兰女王结婚并成为波兰国王，开创该王朝；此后其成员先后登上波希米亚与匈牙利的王位，15至16世纪统治中东欧广大地区。王朝在波兰-立陶宛推行贵族议会制度，1572年西吉斯蒙德二世去世后男系断绝，波兰转入选举君主制。
politics.en: The Jagiellonian dynasty, also known as the House of Jagiellon, was a Polish cadet branch of the Lithuanian ducal dynasty of the Gediminids. It began when Jogaila married the queen of Poland and became king in 1386, and its members later took the thrones of Bohemia and Hungary, ruling much of central and eastern Europe in the fifteenth and sixteenth centuries. The dynasty fostered noble parliamentary institutions in Poland-Lithuania, and with the death of Sigismund II in 1572 the male line ended and Poland turned to an elective monarchy.

economy.zh: 王朝统治下的中东欧以农业庄园与谷物出口为基础，维斯瓦河与波罗的海商路是经济命脉，城市手工业与矿业在14至16世纪发展，克拉科夫与布拉格是商业与文化中心。
economy.en: The economies of its lands rested on agricultural estates and grain exports, with the Vistula and the Baltic routes as lifelines, urban crafts and mining developing between the fourteenth and sixteenth centuries, and Krakow and Prague as centres of commerce and culture.

culture.zh: 雅盖洛时期是中东欧文艺复兴与大学教育的兴盛阶段，克拉科夫大学培养了哥白尼，捷克与波兰的语言文学与印刷业发展，多宗教共存是其社会特征。
culture.en: The Jagiellonian period saw the flourishing of Renaissance learning and university education in central Europe: Copernicus studied at Krakow, Czech and Polish literature and printing developed, and religious plurality marked its society. Its courts also patronised humanist scholars and artists.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1386年雅盖洛成为波兰国王、1410年格伦瓦德战役、15世纪后期家族成员登上波希米亚与匈牙利王位，以及1572年男系断绝。
events.en: Key moments are Jogaila's accession to the Polish throne in 1386, the battle of Grunwald in 1410, the family's accession to the Bohemian and Hungarian thrones in the later fifteenth century and the end of the male line in 1572.

value.zh: 立陶宛格迪米纳斯王朝的波兰支系。
value.en: A Polish cadet branch of the Lithuanian Gediminids.

value.zh: 1572年男系断绝，波兰转入选举君主制。
value.en: The male line ended in 1572 and Poland turned to an elective monarchy.

en: The Swedish Empire, called in Sweden the Great Power Era, as the period of the seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries when Sweden was a European great power
Its territorial control over much of the Baltic region
Its possessions on the far side of the Baltic and in northern Germany
zh: 瑞典帝国在瑞典本国称大国时代，指17世纪至18世纪初瑞典作为欧洲强国的时期
控制波罗的海地区大部
并领有波罗的海对岸与德国北部的领地

politics.zh: 瑞典帝国在瑞典本国称为大国时代，指17世纪至18世纪初瑞典作为欧洲强国、对波罗的海地区大部分行使领土控制的时期。它通过战争取得芬兰、英格里亚、利沃尼亚、爱沙尼亚以及德国北部的波美拉尼亚与不来梅-费尔登等地，形成环绕波罗的海的帝国。1700至1721年的大北方战争后瑞典战败，失去大部分海外领地，大国时代结束。
politics.en: The Swedish Empire, known in Sweden as the Great Power Era, was the period spanning much of the seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries when Sweden was a European great power exercising territorial control over much of the Baltic region. Through war it acquired Finland, Ingria, Livonia, Estonia and territories in northern Germany such as Pomerania and Bremen-Verden, forming an empire around the Baltic. After defeat in the Great Northern War of 1700-1721 Sweden lost most of its overseas provinces and the era ended.

economy.zh: 经济以铜、铁与木材出口为基础，法伦铜矿与瑞典铁矿是欧洲市场的重要来源，波罗的海航运与关税收入支撑国家财政，斯德哥尔摩是行政与商业中心。
economy.en: The economy rested on exports of copper, iron and timber, with the Falun copper mine and Swedish iron works important sources for the European market, Baltic shipping and tolls supporting public finances, and Stockholm as the administrative and commercial centre.

culture.zh: 大国时代瑞典建立起中央集权的行政与军事制度，乌普萨拉大学与古物研究推动了国家历史与语言的研究，巴洛克宫廷文化在斯德哥尔摩发展。
culture.en: In the Great Power Era Sweden built centralised administrative and military institutions, Uppsala University and antiquarian research advanced the study of national history and language, and Baroque court culture developed in Stockholm. Its military reforms were copied across northern Europe.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1611至1632年古斯塔夫二世·阿道夫的改革与征战、1648年威斯特伐利亚和约、1700至1721年大北方战争，以及1721年战败后的领土丧失。
events.en: Key moments are the reforms and campaigns of Gustavus Adolphus from 1611 to 1632, the Peace of Westphalia in 1648, the Great Northern War of 1700-1721 and the loss of territory after defeat in 1721.

value.zh: 17世纪至18世纪初为瑞典的大国时代。
value.en: Its Great Power Era ran from the seventeenth to the early eighteenth century.

value.zh: 大北方战争战败后失去大部分海外领地。
value.en: It lost most of its overseas provinces after defeat in the Great Northern War.
